operators.name: custom_linear
semantics: Computes x = input @ weight.T + bias, where bias is added if provided and present.
Matches reference nn.Linear forward for input shape [128,768], weight [200,768], bias [200].
Uses cuBLAS GEMM mandated for GEMM operations.
Output shape [128,200], dtype float32, device CUDA.

operators.name: custom_kldiv_loss
semantics: Implements KLDivLoss reduction='batchmean' on log_softmax(x, dim=1) and softmax(target, dim=1).
Computes log_softmax along dim=1, softmax along dim=1 for target, then pointwise product sum and batchmean reduction.
Returns scalar float32 tensor on CUDA matching reference.

operators.name: custom_l1_loss_sum
semantics: Computes sum over i=0..num_params-1 of F.l1_loss(x[:, i], params[i].expand_as(x[:, i])).
For each i, computes mean absolute difference between column i of x and scalar params[i] broadcast to batch_size.
Then sums these per-column means.
Returns scalar float32 tensor on CUDA.
Linear layer forward: x = input @ weight.T + bias.
Input [128,768], weight [200,768], bias [200], output [128,200] float32.
F.log_softmax(x, dim=1) applied to x.
F.softmax(target, dim=1) applied to target.
KLDivLoss with reduction='batchmean' computes sum(target_softmax * (log(target_softmax) - log_softmax_x)) / batch_size, where 0*log(0) treated as 0.
Returns scalar float32.

reference_steps.source: l1_loss = sum((F.l1_loss(x[:, i], self.params[i].expand_as(x[:, i])) for i in range(len(self.params))))
semantics: For each i in 0..199, take column x[:, i] of shape [128] and params[i] (scalar [1]) expanded to [128] (same scalar).
F.l1_loss with default reduction='mean' computes mean(|x[:,i] - params[i]|).
Sum these 200 means to get scalar float32.
ParameterList elements are 1-element tensors; broadcast semantics as expand_as.
Returns tuple of two scalar float32 tensors (kldiv_loss, l1_loss).
